cases.detail: Xezim 0.11.4 returns code zero but writes "No error" into the description for a successful file operation, including packed buffers. IEEE 1800-2023 21.3.7 explicitly requires the description to be cleared when the most recent operation did not produce an error. Icarus 13.0 and Celox clear both output forms; the standalone probe prints the difference.
cases.name: file_io::ferror_success_clears_description
